I'm testing something. please run two subagents. one to count all the docs in this folder and one to count all the binary files excluding the target etc. run them both and tell me the result. that's it. nothing else

item.text: I’m counting recursively with an explicit document-extension set, excluding common generated/vendor/build directories.

item.text:
29 documentation files.

Criteria: recursive; names `README`, `CHANGELOG`, `CONTRIBUTING`, `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, `AUTHORS`, or extensions `.md`, `.mdx`, `.markdown`, `.rst`, `.txt`, `.text`, `.adoc`, `.asciidoc`, `.org`, `.rtf`, `.doc`, `.docx`, `.odt`, `.pdf`, `.tex`.

Excluded: `.git`, `node_modules`, `vendor`, `target`, `build`, `dist`, `.next`, `coverage`.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "find . \\( -type d \\( -name .git -o -name target -o -name node_modules -o -name build -o -name dist -o -name .next -o -name vendor -o -name out -o -name coverage -o -name .cache \\) -prune \\) -o -type f -print0 | xargs -0 file --mime | awk '/; charset=binary"'$/ { n++; line=$0; sub(/''^.*: /, "", line); sub(/; charset=binary$/, "", line); types[line]++ } END { print "COUNT=" n; for (t in types) print types[t], t }'"' | LC_ALL=C sort"
